description: This file defines Express.js routes for a web API, including a ping endpoint and a database types listing endpoint. It utilizes the express Router and contains inline OpenAPI documentation annotations.

methods.name: router.get('/ping')
methods.description: GET endpoint at /api/ping that responds with a pong message to verify API reachability.

methods.name: router.get('/databases')
methods.description: GET endpoint at /api/databases that returns a list of supported database types.
